{{Quote|Horliss-Horliss!! You've thrown a shape too! Oh, spiteful copy!!|Tilotny|<ref name="tilotny" />}}
'''Horliss-Horliss''' was one of the four [[Bedlam Spirits]], transdimensional beings that resided in the [[Bedlam Pulsar/Legends|Bedlam Pulsar]] and appeared to have completely omnipotent powers over time and matter. Horliss-Horliss frequently argued with its fellow Spirits, especially [[Tilotny]], but joined them in occasional experiments on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]]. In one such experiment Horliss-Horliss [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] by turning her [[Heart/Legends|heart]] to [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]], only for Organa to be restored to life soon after when the Spirit lost interest.

==Biography==
{{Quote|An unsubtle change, vulgar Tilotny. This first tiny mover has things inside it to make it work. They are soft things... I shall make them hard things.|Horliss-Horliss|<ref name="tilotny" />}}
Horliss-Horliss was one of four omnipotent, transdimensional beings known as the [[Bedlam Spirits]], along with [[Tilotny]], [[Cold Danda Sine]] and [[Splendid Ap]]. Most commonly encountered in the [[Bedlam Pulsar/Legends|Bedlam Pulsar]], the Spirits were said to reside in the "whiteness" within the fabric of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]],<ref name="TEA" /> and from time to time alighted upon the rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]] during their endless experiments upon the fabric of space-time and the nature of matter itself. On one visit to Bedlam during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the four Bedlam Spirits happened upon a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] chasing after [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], who had been stranded on the world.<ref name="tilotny" />

Bemused and intrigued by the "tiny movers," the Bedlam Spirits began to experiment upon the organics&mdash;Horliss-Horliss, after discovering that Organa was kept alive by "soft things" within her body, killed Organa by turning her [[Heart/Legends|heart]] into a [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]]. The Spirits lost interest soon afterward, and set Splendid Ap to restoring the organics to their previous state, although Splendid Ap mistakenly sent the stormtroopers 8,000 years back in time.<ref name="tilotny" /> Some knowledge of Horliss-Horliss and its fellow Spirits' existence filtered out in the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in the decades to come, as visitors to Bedlam discovered impossibly transmuted materials and objects thrown wildly through time.<ref name="TEA" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Myself, I am tired of shape and substance. Let us leave, Cold Danda.|Horliss-Horliss|<ref name="tilotny" />}}
Appearing as a shifting, wispy blob of [[Color/Legends|purple]] and pink, Horliss-Horliss often argued with Tilotny, regarding its fellow Bedlam Spirit as shallow and jealous&mdash;in turn Tilotny derided Horliss-Horliss, while admitting that the being was clever. Horliss-Horliss was adept at a practice called "metastyling," which was considered advanced by its fellow Bedlam Spirits, along with a number of other powers over matter, time, and life and death itself. Horliss-Horliss was intrigued by shape and substance, but quickly became bored with it soon after beginning experiments.<ref name="tilotny" />

==Behind the scenes==
Horliss-Horliss appeared in ''[[Tilotny Throws a Shape]]'', a short comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and illustrated by [[John Stokes]], and originally appearing in ''[[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 154]]'' in the United Kingdom.<ref name="tilotny" />
